items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Charlie Love was playing second trumpet in my band. I was playing first trumpet.

ctx.x: I know of him, Joe Martinez.

Joe, yeah, yeah, yeah. He was living out in Metry. And he was an old classical piano player. And that man, as long as I've been in that band, I think he touched the piano one time, and that was the show off. He called himself showing off. You understand? And with that band, played some kind of classical stuff. It was remarkable. And he said he never touched the piano. He said he might play the piano about once a year. And he was an old fellow at that time. But boy, I mean, the technique he used and everything was…
